title: 库奇·机库长光
description: 库奇保持约德尔飞行员体形，在停稳的飞机座舱中远望机库门，螺旋桨与所有装备静止，强光分出机翼与白胡须。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Corki is a small adult yordle pilot with an enormous white moustache, aviator cap, large goggles, compact furry face, and fully covering flight jacket, gloves, trousers, and boots. Preserve his distinctive rounded aircraft with visible wings, propeller, and brass fittings. The aircraft is firmly parked and all propellers and mounted equipment remain motionless, without firing, flight trails, or combat imagery.
art_direction.scene: Frame the parked craft from a low three-quarter angle at the threshold of a vast hangar, with Corki seated upright and hands resting away from controls. A broad hard beam of sunrise strikes one wing and his white moustache. Deep angular wax-crayon shadows, receding roof girders, and a thin horizon beyond the door give the still scene scale.
art_direction.palette: mustard yellow, leather brown, steel blue, sunrise ivory
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
